bug_info.bug_desc:
The CV-X-IF issue request did not carry the core's current privilege mode. In the old cvxif_fu module there was no priv_lvl_i input, and cvxif_req_o.x_issue_req.mode was never assigned, so the struct field remained at its default ('0) value after the zero-initialization of cvxif_req_o. The ex_stage instantiation of cvxif_fu_i also did not connect any privilege-level signal. As a result, whenever the core issued an instruction to the coprocessor, the coprocessor received a constant/incorrect mode instead of the core's actual privilege level, violating the spec requirement to provide the current privilege mode with each issue request.

【审阅修订(zihan 2026-08-18):HUNK_0003(ex_stage.sv 的 .priv_lvl_i 实例连接)由 filtered 移入 candidate,bug_lineno 相应补齐 core/ex_stage.sv 第 365 行——多文件 benchmark 的答案键应覆盖模型必须修改的全部位置,该缺失连接是修复不可或缺的一部分。】
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a riscv::priv_lvl_t priv_lvl_i input to cvxif_fu, assign cvxif_req_o.x_issue_req.mode from priv_lvl_i when the issue request is valid, and wire the core's priv_lvl_i signal to the cvxif_fu_i instance in core/ex_stage.sv.
